hero.title: Calm software for teams with a lot to do
hero.description: Taskify exists so teams can stop chasing updates and start finishing work. One place for projects, people and progress, designed to stay out of your way.

story.title: Built because busy teams deserve better
paragraphs: Most teams don't fail because of hard problems. They lose time to scattered messages, forgotten follow-ups and nobody being quite sure who owns what.
We built Taskify to fix that. Every task has an owner, a priority and a clear stage, so anyone can see where things stand without asking. It works the same on your phone and on the web.
We keep the product focused on purpose. No ads, no trackers and no features that exist only to keep you scrolling. Just the tools a team needs to plan, track and ship.

values.title: The principles behind every screen
values.description: A few ideas we come back to whenever we decide what to build next.

items.title: Clarity over clutter
items.description: Every screen answers one question well. If a feature makes the app harder to read, it doesn't ship.

items.title: Private by default
items.description: Your work belongs to you. We never sell data, and biometrics never leave your device.

items.title: Made for teams
items.description: Ownership, assignments and activity history are built in, so collaboration feels natural.

items.title: Fast everywhere
items.description: Opening the app, moving a task, finding a project. Every interaction should feel instant.

items.title: Listen first
items.description: Feedback from real teams shapes the roadmap. Every message to our inbox is read by a person.

items.title: Ship carefully
items.description: We test changes on our own projects before they reach yours, so updates feel like improvements, not surprises.

items.title: Stay honest
items.description: Plain-language privacy, transparent changes and no dark patterns. If something breaks, we tell you.

cta.title: Let's get your team organised
cta.description: Download Taskify and create your first project in under a minute, or reach out if you have questions.
